title: How Small Are We?
question: Does being small make us matter less, or more?

lines.say: [softly] This tiny dot is Earth... seen from six billion kilometres away.
[thoughtful] Everyone you've ever loved. Every war. Every heartbreak. [pause] All of it... on a speck of dust.
[softly] And here we are... worrying about a message we sent. A bad day. [pause] Someone who didn't call back.
[calm] From far enough away... none of it can be seen.
[warmly] But up close... one small kindness can feel bigger than a galaxy.
[thoughtful] Maybe being small makes our problems lighter... [pause] or maybe it makes every feeling rarer.
[whispers] So does being small make us matter less... [pause] or more?

music_prompt: Calm ambient piano, slow and spacious, soft synth pad, gentle celesta, warm reverb, quiet intro and a soft ending. Instrumental.
